## 2. Your appeal letter

[Your name]  
[Your address]  
[Your phone number]  
[Date]

[Insurer appeals department address — on your denial letter or member portal]

RE: Formal Internal Appeal  
Member: [name]  
Member ID: [member ID]  
Claim/Reference Number: 00000000  
Date of Service: 09/14/2026  
Service: MRI lumbar spine without contrast (CPT 72148)  
Provider: Example Imaging Center

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

This is a formal internal appeal of the denial dated October 2, 2026, of my MRI lumbar spine without contrast performed on September 14, 2026. The denial stated the service was "not deemed a medical necessity by the payer" because "policy IMG-204 requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative therapy unless red-flag findings are present."

I meet both criteria in the policy — either one alone satisfies the requirement. I completed eight weeks of physical therapy and naproxen treatment before the MRI was ordered, which is more than the six weeks the policy requires. The physical therapy records showing treatment dates from [start date] through [end date] and the prescription records are enclosed [list what you attach].

Additionally, I developed new left-leg weakness and numbness in late August, which is a red-flag neurologic finding that satisfies the policy's exception for immediate imaging. My orthopedist ordered the MRI urgently because these symptoms — progressive weakness and numbness — indicated possible nerve compression that required evaluation to decide whether surgery was needed. The enclosed letter from my orthopedist and the clinic note from [date of visit when symptoms were documented] document these neurologic symptoms and the medical necessity of the MRI to guide surgical decision-making.

[I have asked my orthopedist's office to send the complete records directly to your appeals department — delete if not done.]

The records the plan reviewed apparently did not include the documentation of my conservative treatment or the neurologic symptoms. The complete records are enclosed with this appeal.

I request the following:
- The complete text of policy IMG-204, including the specific clinical criteria and any listed red-flag findings
- The name, credentials, and specialty of the physician reviewer who made the determination
- A copy of all medical records and documents considered in the denial decision

Please authorize the MRI claim or reprocess it as medically necessary. If this appeal is denied, I will pursue external review as provided under federal and state law.

I request a written decision within the timeframe required by the plan and federal rules.

Sincerely,

[Your signature]  
[Your name]

**Enclosures:**  
[List what you attach — for example: Letter from Dr. [orthopedist name], Physical therapy records from [dates], Prescription records, Clinic note from [date]]
data.clock: for employer and marketplace plans, the plan must decide an appeal for care already received within 60 days of receiving it (30 days per level if it has two appeal levels); care already received is never expedited
